items.name: file-dropzone
items.title: File Dropzone
items.description: Browse or drop files with client-side type, size, and count limits.

items.name: upload-progress
items.title: Upload Progress
items.description: Separate bars for file transfer and server processing with optional cancel and retry actions.

items.name: attachment-list
items.title: Attachment List
items.description: A list of file attachments with optional thumbnails, downloads, and remove actions.

items.name: use-list-keyboard-nav
items.title: List Keyboard Navigation
items.description: Native-focus keyboard navigation between a search input and a dynamic list of focusable items.

items.name: creatable-combobox
items.title: Creatable Combobox
items.description: A searchable combobox with grouped options, free-form values, and a create-new action.

items.name: callout
items.title: Callout
items.description: An attention-drawing callout with info, success, warning, and destructive variants.

items.name: infobox
items.title: Infobox
items.description: A fandom-style infobox that renders titled sections, tabbed images, tabbed section groups, and label/value rows from a JSON data object.

items.name: side-panel
items.title: Side Panel
items.description: A viewport-stable side panel layout primitive (fixed rail + in-flow gap) that pushes main content beside it when open, with provider, inset, trigger, and icon tab.

items.name: collection-view
items.title: Collection View
items.description: A data collection that flips between a TanStack Table v9 data table and a card grid, with centered top/bottom pagination, customizable page-size options, column visibility toggles, optional toolbar search, client or server-driven sorting/pagination, and grid-only infinite scroll.

items.name: chat-panel
items.title: Chat Panel
items.description: A presentational chat shell composed on the Side Panel viewport-stable layout primitive.

items.name: sortable
items.title: Sortable
items.description: Drag-and-drop reorderable list (pointer + keyboard) built on dnd-kit, with item wrappers and a Button grip handle.

items.name: auth-admin-guard
items.title: Auth Admin Guard
items.description: Requires @cyphix/auth-react installed by the app (file:../pkg/goauth/web/auth-react; not published on npm). Shared auth admin guard.

items.name: auth-login-form
items.title: Auth Login Form
items.description: Requires @cyphix/auth-react installed by the app (file:../pkg/goauth/web/auth-react; not published on npm). Shared auth login form.

items.name: auth-profile-card
items.title: Auth Profile Card
items.description: Requires @cyphix/auth-react installed by the app (file:../pkg/goauth/web/auth-react; not published on npm). Shared auth profile card.

items.name: auth-passkeys-card
items.title: Auth Passkeys Card
items.description: Requires @cyphix/auth-react installed by the app (file:../pkg/goauth/web/auth-react; not published on npm). Shared auth passkeys card.

items.name: auth-users-card
items.title: Auth Users Card
items.description: Requires @cyphix/auth-react installed by the app (file:../pkg/goauth/web/auth-react; not published on npm). Shared auth users card.

items.name: time-input
items.title: Time Input
items.description: Validated 12-hour or 24-hour time entry with an optional popup picker, plus a paired date+time field sharing one canonical YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm(:ss) value.
